meta.title: A Rust + React starter with a point of view.
meta.description: A production-minded Rust + Axum + SQLx starter with React 19, RBAC, i18n and 38 color themes.

hero.title: Start with the parts nobody wants to rebuild.
hero.description: Auth, roles, user management, settings, localization and a themeable shadcn shell. A production-minded Rust + React base for the thing that is actually yours.
hero.note: Rust, Axum, SQLx, React 19 and 38 themes. Demo accounts use the password "password".

themes.title: 38 palettes. One system.
themes.description: The mode and the palette are independent. Pick light, dark or system, then give it a Stripe, Dracula, Nord or Catppuccin surface. The choice is a cookie away from the next request.

features.title: The work you keep repeating, already done.
features.description: The boilerplate covers the parts that are expensive to get right and easy to get wrong. The domain is yours.

auth.title: Auth that behaves
auth.body: Email and password, verification, reset, TOTP 2FA, a confirm-password gate and an approval mode that actually blocks pending accounts.

rbac.title: Permissions with a spine
rbac.body: One role per user, a permission matrix, protected superadmins and escalation checks inside the actions, not only in the sidebar.

shell.title: A shell that ships
shell.body: Sidebar, breadcrumbs, settings, profile, password, appearance, security and account deletion. One title per page, consistent forms and a real empty state.

data.title: Typed end to end
data.body: SQLx migrations, a typed Rust API, shared Zod schemas and a seed that creates enough data to make the screens real.

design.title: A design baseline
design.body: The Stripe-inspired default and 37 OpenCode palettes, semantic tokens and Altics icons. Swap the identity without rebuilding the UI.

ops.title: Boring operations
ops.body: One Postgres, one Dockerfile, a Compose stack, a seed and a Makefile. The deployment story stays obvious.

stack.title: Boring in the right places.
stack.description: One API, one database, one UI layer. The choices are deliberate, and the quality gates run in CI.
stack.note: Plus React Router, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Sonner and Recharts.

demo.title: Try the actual app.
demo.description: The demo is seeded with three roles and enough users to make the dashboard, tables and charts feel real. No setup, no sales call.

footer.tagline: A Rust starter with a point of view.
footer.built: Built with Rust, Axum, SQLx, React and Altics icons.
